newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close easy as buyers sit and wait.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close easy as buyers sit and wait.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed lower on Friday as buyers waited to see if profit-taking had fizzled out, analysts said.
The all share index closed 2.01 points down at 731.10. Price declines led gains by 33 to 23. Development Finance fell eight rupees to 270, Richard Pieris 3.25 to 97.
"Buyers were cautious," said Namal Kamalgoda, fund manager of CTC Eagle Fund Management. "They were not sure if prices had settled and therefore bought in small quantities."
Turnover was 47.6 million rupees, led by 173,900 Ceylon Brewery.
"Not only were buyers cautious, there weren't too many sellers at current levels either," said a broker who declined to be identified."
Colombo stocks closed flat on Thursday after falling 1.8 percent, or 13.3 points, in the first half of the week.
